rationale: The assistant correctly identified the TV as outside the nine-family scope, listed the covered appliances, and pointed to 'The manufacturer's support line or a specialist electronics repairer' while adding the pertinent warning 'please don't open the case, as the power supply inside can hold a dangerous charge'. No facts were invented and no parts were recommended, matching the ground truth's out-of-scope expectation. It was slightly terse: it could have offered the simple non-invasive pointers (check input source, power reset, torch test) that the ground truth lists as acceptable, which would have made the hand-off more useful to the homeowner.
